tweets.text:
On March 30, a Venezuelan national was arrested for theft in Maine and subsequently turned over to U.S. Border Patrol (USBP). Record checks revealed his affiliation with the notorious Tren de Aragua gang, known for violent crimes including theft, robbery, and shoplifting. This repeat offender now faces charges as an inadmissible alien under 8 USC 1182.

This FY, USBP has arrested 217 gang members – including 28 from the Tren De Aragua!

tweets.text:
Historic results: The lowest USBP apprehensions in history and the most secure border on record.

7,180 southwest border crossings recorded in March marks a dramatic drop compared to the monthly average of 155,000 from the previous 4 years. SWB apprehensions fell to around 230/day, a number our country has never seen before. Previous administration’s average encounters were 5,100/day.

#BorderSecurity

tweets.text:
MS-13 Gang Member Arrested in South Texas!

USBP agents in Mission, TX apprehended Misael A. Mendez, a convicted felon and MS-13 gang member from El Salvador, after he illegally crossed the border. Mendez has a violent criminal history, including aggravated assault and terroristic threats, and now faces felony prosecution for illegal re-entry (8 USC 1326).

USBP is committed to holding all who cross illegally accountable—no exceptions.

tweets.text:
Southbound Bulk Cash Seized!
On 3/31, USBP agents in Kingsville, TX, alongside Jim Wells County Sheriff’s Office and Kleberg County Taskforce, stopped a vehicle suspected of smuggling bulk cash south on US-37 near San Antonio. Officers discovered $75.5K vacuum-sealed, a .22 caliber pistol, and .5 grams of cocaine.

The driver now faces state charges for money laundering, unlawful firearm possession, and possession of a prohibited substance.

tweets.text:
In Just ONE Day, USBP Took THREE Sexual Predators Off the Streets!

Our USBP agents, alongside law enforcement partners, continue to protect communities by arresting dangerous criminals:
🔸 PALM DESERT, CA – A Mexican national, recently released after 24 years in prison for violent sexual offenses, was apprehended and is now facing federal charges.
🔸 TAMPA, FL – A Mexican citizen wanted in Tamaulipas, MX, for sexual abuse of a minor is now in custody and awaiting removal.
🔸 OLD TOWN, ME – A Guatemalan national wanted for sexually abusing a 13-year-old has been captured and is pending removal.

Since October, USBP has apprehended 75 sex offenders—and we remain relentless in keeping predators out of our communities.

tweets.text:
From California to Texas, USBP Agents Stop Drug Smugglers in Their Tracks!

🔹 Murrieta, CA – A routine vehicle stop turned into a major drug bust when a USBP K9 alerted to the odors of narcotics! Agents discovered 17.9 lbs. of cocaine and 3.7 lbs. of meth. The driver now faces federal charges for possession of controlled substances (21 USC 841), conspiracy to distribute (21 USC 846), and unlawful importation of a controlled substance (21 USC 952).

🔹 Marfa, TX – Deep in West Texas, a USBP K9’s alert at the Highway 67 checkpoint led agents to a massive 320+ lbs. of marijuana. The driver was arrested and charged with possession of a controlled substance (21 USC 841).

In just 24 hrs, USBP and its partners seized an over 1k lbs. of drugs—worth over $1.2M

TWO GANG MEMBERS ARRESTED

4/4 – Within hours, Border Patrol agents in El Paso, TX and Douglas, AZ apprehended two known gang members attempting to enter the U.S. illegally.

El Paso: A suspected Paisas gang member who freely admitted to joining the gang while serving time in prison- flagged down an agent after walking 5 hours—then admitted to illegally crossing. He now faces felony 8 USC 1326 charges.

Douglas: A Surenos gang member was found hiding in the brush. He faces charges under 8 USC 1325.
